<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 276.0666, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈275.059 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈16 % M+1) suggests ~17 carbon atoms. A formula that matches this mass within typical MS tolerance and fits the C/H/O/N pattern is C₁₇H₉O₃N. This satisfies the required format CxHyOzX (with X = N).</thought>
<final_answer>C17H9O3N</final_answer>
